assumptions: Content-Type must be exactly application/json; other media, including a missing header, is 415. Charset and case variants are not accepted.
401, 404, and 405 bodies are empty. 400 is invalid input, 415 is unsupported media type, 503 is store unavailable, GET /public is public, and 201 is the encoded public JSON with no content-type.
404 and method mismatch record only root-before and root-after and do not enter the protected group. Allow comes from the prepared table.
OPTIONS and malformed targets are exhaustive router cases, not specified by the task: 204 with allow, and 400 with an empty body, both root-only.
Public JSON field order is owner, title, published. The journal is that encoding plus a newline. The same File from state or File.write is returned on every path; it is never reopened.
adapters: dispatch takes +app because the copyable plan is used for policy lookup, the root scope, and finish.
Decoded input is an affine Input wrapper around Contract.Record so it fits Surface.endpoint's Result<&2, &1, E, I> slot.
Auth context is Owner{id: U32}, not a token string. Bearer alice is 7 and Bearer bob is 8.
Template callbacks stay affine. Extra uses of the plan, metadata, hook, and error are in .go helpers, as in surface_app.bend.
File.write is used as IO(File & Result<&1, &1, U32 & String, Unit>). The journal string is Enc.utf8.decode of encode, because Http.from_string is one character per octet.
